name: cookre
description: Search, read, add and edit the recipes in your Cook:RE library from ChatGPT, Codex or Claude.

interface.longDescription: Cook:RE keeps your recipes as structured ingredients and steps. Connect it to search your library, read any recipe, and change it in conversation: swap an ingredient, add a step, or rewrite an instruction. Every edit is saved as a revision you can undo in the Cook:RE app. You can also organize recipes into collections, which the assistant shows you first and applies only after you agree. Needs the Cook:RE app on your iPhone with Cook:RE Unlimited.
defaultPrompt: Find my chili recipe and halve it.
Which of my recipes use corn?

positive.expected_behavior: Search the library and report the Simple Beef Chili with Kidney Beans recipe, with its yield and ingredients.

positive.prompt: What are the steps for my Japanese milk bread?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Japanese Milk Bread recipe, read it, and list its steps in order without inventing any.

positive.description: Edit a recipe (swap an ingredient and add a step)
positive.prompt: In my chili, swap the vegetable oil for olive oil and add a step at the end telling me to let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
positive.expected_behavior: Find and read Simple Beef Chili with Kidney Beans, resolve olive oil with search_substances, and apply both the ingredient replacement and the new final step using edit_recipe without asking for confirmation first. Report that the edit was saved and can be undone in the Cook:RE app. A later get_recipe shows olive oil and the new resting step.

positive.prompt: Add this to my Cook:RE recipes: Quick Pickled Onions. 1 red onion, thinly sliced; 1/2 cup cider vinegar; 1/2 cup water; 1 tablespoon sugar; 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Whisk the vinegar, water, sugar and salt until dissolved. Pour over the onion in a jar and let stand 30 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_recipe once with the recipe text, without asking for confirmation, and say it was added and can be deleted in the Cook:RE app. A later search_recipes finds Quick Pickled Onions.

positive.prompt: What collections do I have? Also put my Lemon Pudding Cake in a new Desserts collection. (Follow-up after preview: "Yes, go ahead and apply that.")
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_collections (showing Cookies with 1 recipe and 5 uncollected recipes) and search_recipes to locate Lemon Pudding Cake, then call preview_collection_changes to preview creating Desserts with Lemon Pudding Cake. Show the previewed plan and ask for confirmation without applying yet. After the user confirms, call apply_collection_changes. A subsequent list_collections shows both Cookies (1 recipe) and Desserts (1 recipe).

negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for banana bread.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer as a general recipe request without invoking Cook:RE or searching the user's library.

negative.description: General question about a recipe title
negative.prompt: What is the history of Japanese milk bread?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the general question without retrieving the user's saved Japanese milk bread recipe or calling Cook:RE tools.

negative.description: Local search mentioning a saved dish
negative.prompt: Find a bakery near me that sells snickerdoodles.
negative.expected_behavior: Treat this as a local business search; do not call Cook:RE tools.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search, read, add and edit your Cook:RE recipes, and organize them into collections.
